links.outcome: Readability (FKGL, SMOG) and actionability of LLM answers for autism caregivers versus patient education benchmarks
links.effect: All three LLMs exceeded readability benchmarks (FKGL ≤ 6, SMOG ≤ 8; all p < 0.001). ChatGPT was most readable (FKGL 7.86; SMOG 9.97). All fell short of the AHRQ 80% actionability benchmark (all p < 0.001).
links.quote: Importantly, all models failed to meet established consumer education standards for readability and actionability.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates three off-the-shelf LLMs across standardized questions for autism caregivers assessing accuracy, readability, understandability, and neurodiversity-affirming language, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
